card.name: Web address start in resource links
card.fires_on: The :// after http or https at the start of a web address, and sometimes .gov in the domain, when the text points readers to a health agency page or test list.

modes.label: Colon-slashes after http
modes.description: The :// piece right after http or https in a URL that directs readers to more information.

modes.label: Domain ending
modes.description: The .gov part of a government site address inside a URL.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward continuing the URL with web-path pieces, though the promoted tokens look mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up at the start of a web link when the text sends you to a website for more information.
